note: a CrossOver bottle switched to the pinned engine with DXVK: the CrossOver wineserver is stopped (CX_ROOT), DXVK is installed through the scripted installer, the marker becomes pinned:<current> with its DXVK copy
a version: 2 marker (a newer build wrote it) with a real engine change asked: refused as marker-newer, nothing stopped or installed, the marker bytes unchanged
a marker cut off mid-write: the gate reports unreadable, which is writable, so the engine is inferred (the pin) and the marker rewritten; the prefix itself is untouched
Rust cannot be asked about the marker: the gate is treated as newer, an engine change is refused and the marker bytes stay as they were
